using namespace std;

using i64 = long long;

const i64 MOD = 1000000007;

struct DSU {
    vector<i64> parent;
    vector<i64> rank;

    DSU(i64 n) : parent(n), rank(n, 0) {
        for (i64 i = 0; i < n; ++i) parent[i] = i;
    }

    i64 find(i64 x) {
        if (parent[x] != x) parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
        return parent[x];
    }

    void unite(i64 x, i64 y) {
        x = find(x); y = find(y);
        if (x == y) return;
        if (rank[x] < rank[y]) swap(x, y);
        parent[y] = x;
        if (rank[x] == rank[y]) ++rank[x];
    }
};

i64 count_cycles(i64 p, i64 k) {
    DSU dsu(p);
    for (i64 i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        i64 ki = (k * i) % p;
        dsu.unite(i, ki);
    }
    vector<bool> seen(p, false);
    i64 cnt = 0;
    for (i64 i = 1; i < p; ++i) {
        i64 r = dsu.find(i);
        if (!seen[r]) {
            seen[r] = true;
            ++cnt;
        }
    }
    return cnt;
}

    i64 cycles;
    if (k == 0) cycles = p - 1;
    else if (k == 1) cycles = p;
    else cycles = count_cycles(p, k);

    i64 res = 1;
    for (i64 i = 0; i < cycles; ++i) {
        res = (res * p) % MOD;

    return res;
}
